system.description:
This device is designed to be used with either the enhanced vision augmentation (p. 301) or specs (p. 325). It emits a focused beam of low-powered x-rays that allows the user of either device to both see and see through most objects using backscatter x-ray radiation (p. 303). This allows the character to literally see through walls and into containers, including ones made of metal.

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 317.
